plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Safety and review of Claude's output. Six mods, each toggled in the plugin config. blast-radius: holds destructive shell commands (rm -rf, git push --force, git reset --hard, DROP TABLE...) behind a card showing the files at risk; pick Proceed or Cancel. secret-sentry: denies Write/Edit/NotebookEdit that would put API keys, tokens or private keys in a file (.env and *.example exempt). reflect: spots lasting corrections in your prompts (or 'remember: ...') and offers to save them to ./CLAUDE.md or ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md; /reflect-queue, /reflect-pause. assumption-tracker: after each turn lists what Claude assumed; mark Right or Wrong and send a fix for the wrong ones; /assumptions. self-critique: /critique [auto|opus|sonnet|haiku] reviews Claude's last answer with a verdict, flaws and a Make this fix button. prompt-coach: holds the first prompt of a session (once per session, tracked per session id so a reload cannot re-fire it) and interviews you one question at a time (with options) in a side pane, then writes an improved prompt (role, goal, context, requirements, constraints, acceptance criteria) with your original quoted; Use, Copy, Request changes or Dismiss (sends the original); a first prompt that is already clear shows 'Looks good' and is sent as is; a first prompt with attachments is sent as typed and the improved text is only offered to copy; /sharpen <prompt> runs it on demand.

plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: Live panes and bands for session awareness. While all is calm, mods share one dim status line above the prompt (Details expands it into full cards with rings, bars and buttons); a mod draws its own band only when it needs attention. Seven mods, each toggled in the plugin config. agents-progress: running-subagents and todo bands above the prompt; /agents-info opens the full subagent panel. cache-keeper: cache countdown in the last 5 minutes or when cold, cold-send dialog (continue here or new session) with cost estimate; /keepwarm [90m|2h|off|status] pings to hold the cache, /cache-tax shows its state. context-health: context fill band with warnings, Handoff and Fresh buttons; /ctx-handoff writes .claude/handoff.md and continues in a clean context, /autohandoff [percent|off] does it automatically. usage-limits: always-on session (5h) and weekly (7d) limit bars with reset countdown, pace and a toast at 90%. filetree: /filetree opens a file tree with git status and highlights for files Claude reads, edits and commits. next-steps: three suggested next prompts after each turn; click one to fill the prompt. token-meter: the status line shows tokens used this session; Details shows input, output and cache tokens, the project's total across past sessions of this folder (click to rescan), session cost (last turn, per turn) and tokens per model.

plugins.name: toolbox
plugins.description: General-purpose skills, triggered by plain requests or named directly. commit-changes ('commit this'): commits the session's changes as atomic Conventional Commits with a why-first body, splits unrelated work, adds ticket refs (#123, PROJ-123), leaves other dirty files alone, never pushes. create-pr ('open a PR'): pushes the branch and opens or updates a PR filled from the repo's template (or a built-in one) with why, what, verification and review focus; drops commits already merged by squash. github-repo-setup ('set up this repo properly'): via gh, creates or hardens a repo with a branch-protection ruleset, squash-only merges, CI, CodeQL, Dependabot, CODEOWNERS, PR template, LICENSE, SECURITY.md, secret scanning and optional signed commits.
